en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the
Aqeeqa, so heasws said: ‘Aqeeqa of the boy and the girl, is a ram, a ram’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ’Isma‘il ibn Marrar Yunus from ibn Muskan who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about ‘Aqiqah and he (the Imam) said, ‘ ‘Aqiqah for a boy and a girl is the same, one ram for this and one ram for this.’”
